greeting: Morning, Haniel. It's Wednesday — deploy day and takeoff day. Let's make both happen.
hype: The billing system has been built and tested — today you get it live and start the painting revenue pipeline. Every block on this schedule closes something real.

prep.what: Get the AZ Team billing system live on the production VPS — LEMP stack, queue worker, TLS, MySQL 8.
prep.understand: Deploy topology is bare-metal LEMP on azteam-vps (Docker was tried and reverted). redeploy.sh is entry point; vps-deploy.sh is STALE. CACHE_STORE must be `database`. Scheduler stays OFF until t39 passes.
approach: SSH to azteam-vps alias and pull latest main branch.
Run `./deploy/redeploy.sh` — watch for migration errors and seeder warnings.
Verify Caddy + Let's Encrypt TLS at https://fin.azteam.cloud (health check endpoint).
Confirm supervisor has app + queue worker running; leave scheduler commented out / disabled.
resources: app/Console/Kernel.php (find the scheduler, comment it out)
DEPLOY.md if present in the repo

prep.what: Populate all production secrets in .env.production on the VPS before anything runs live.
prep.understand: ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD required (seeder throws if missing). Both Stripe modes need keys. After writing, MUST run `php artisan config:cache` (same OPcache trap as t72 in az-takeoff).
approach: SSH to VPS, open/create /opt/azteamai-system/.env.production.
Set: APP_KEY, STRIPE_KEY + STRIPE_SECRET (both test_ and live_ keys), STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, CHATWOOT_API_TOKEN + CHATWOOT_BASE_URL, MAIL_* driver, ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD.
Run `php artisan config:cache && php artisan route:cache`.
Verify with `php artisan tinker` → `config('services.stripe.secret`)`.

prep.what: Build the standalone reconciliation gate — extract CrmImporter::reconcile() (~L277) into ReconciliationGateService + `billing:reconcile-cutover` artisan command.
prep.understand: Logic already exists in CrmImporter::reconcile(). Must be rerunnable, public service. PASS = only safe proceed signal. Blocks enabling the scheduler (t40).
approach: Open CrmImporter.php, find reconcile() (~L277).
Create app/Billing/ReconciliationGateService.php — move logic into public reconcile(bool $verbose=true): bool.
Create app/Console/Commands/ReconcileCutover.php — call service, print per-client breakdown, exit 0/1.
Register in Kernel.php, run `php artisan billing:reconcile-cutover` against imported data.
resources: azteam_crm database (SSH tunnel for ground truth)
9 imported clients list from t38 notes

prep.what: Add `per_linear_ft` to RateType enum, wire `lf` unit label in LineItemFactory, seed a trim LaborRate row.
prep.understand: RateType controls unit labels and labor cost calculation. New PerLinearFt case needed in enum, unitFromRateType(), and as a seeded LaborRate. Unlocks t48 (pricing takeoff lines).
approach: Add `PerLinearFt = 'per_linear_ft'` to app/Enums/RateType.php and a human label.
In LineItemFactory::unitFromRateType(), add `lf` mapping.
In LaborRateSeeder.php, add 'Trim (per linear ft)' row.
Run `php artisan db:seed --class=LaborRateSeeder` and verify.

prep.what: In TakeoffEstimateSeeder.php, switch on measurement kind to route each to the right trade: floor area(SF)→flooring, derived wall SF→painting, LF→trim, count(EA)→doors/tile.
prep.understand: Currently all measurements collapse into one anonymous kind=custom $0 line. Need switch on kind. isCoreTrade() helper exists on ProjectType for core/subbed tagging. Wall SF lines come from t45.
approach: Open TakeoffEstimateSeeder.php, find where measurements collapse to 'custom'.
Add switch on `$measurement->kind`: area→flooring, line→trim/LF, count→doors.
Use `ProjectType::isCoreTrade($trade)` for trade tagging.
Leave wall/paint as stub kind='wall_paint' if t45 not done yet.
Test by seeding a takeoff project and verifying distinct line items appear.

prep.what: Add wall_height_ft to estimates (nullable column + migration), preserve geometry.rings in seeder, compute SF=perimeter×height per room, emit 'Wall paint area' line per room.
prep.understand: 2D plan has no height — needs a project-level default field. Perimeter from engine (geometry.rings or meta.perimeter). Seeder currently DROPS geometry — must stop dropping it. This completes the missing painting revenue measure Rafa flagged.
approach: Generate migration: add nullable `wall_height_ft` float to estimates table; run it.
Add 'Wall height (ft)' numeric field to estimate form (Estimates/Edit.vue or Create.vue).
In TakeoffEstimateSeeder.php, stop discarding `geometry` — read `geometry.rings` or `meta.perimeter` per room.
For each room, compute `perimeter_ft × wall_height_ft` = wall paint sqft; emit 'Wall paint area' line using painting labor rate.
Test with a real CT Pros blueprint — verify each room produces a painting line with non-zero sqft.
resources: Takeoff engine API response shape (geometry.rings / meta.perimeter)

waiting_on.title: CASA Tier 2 + Meta review + LGPD legal
